spec.statement:
EXECUTE STATEMENT SET
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO bayno_file_results
 SELECT file_id,source_file,status,reason,CAST(declared_count AS STRING),CAST(actual_count AS STRING),
   CAST(invalid_count AS STRING),CAST(error_percent AS STRING),source_system,feed_type,file_sequence
 FROM bayno_final_files;

 INSERT INTO bayno_details
 SELECT f.file_id,s.source_file,CAST(s.line_number AS STRING),f.source_system,f.feed_type,f.file_sequence,
   s.record_type,s.c2,s.c3,s.c4,s.c5,s.c6,s.c7
 FROM bayno_stage_events s JOIN bayno_final_files f ON s.source_file=f.source_file
 WHERE f.status='ACCEPTED' AND s.record_type='01' AND s.row_error IS NULL;

 INSERT INTO bayno_exceptions
 SELECT f.file_id,s.source_file,CAST(s.line_number AS STRING),s.row_error,
   CASE WHEN s.parse_error IS NOT NULL THEN s.parse_error
     ELSE 'Invalid detail: check required fields, ISO date, HHMM time and field count' END
 FROM bayno_stage_events s JOIN bayno_final_files f ON s.source_file=f.source_file
 WHERE s.record_type='01' AND s.row_error IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT file_id,source_file,CAST(COALESCE(trailer_line,0) AS STRING),file_error,
   CASE WHEN file_error='COUNT_MISMATCH' THEN CONCAT('Declared ',CAST(declared_count AS STRING),', found ',CAST(actual_count AS STRING))
     ELSE CONCAT('File check failed: ',file_error) END
 FROM bayno_final_files WHERE file_error IS NOT NULL;
END;
